extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral applicants and proposed host institutions (prospective Banting Fellowship applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview and program-level requirements for applicants seeking Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships, including program objectives, what the program prioritizes (applicant merit, leadership potential, applicant–host synergy), procedural requirements (host endorsement, timelines), and award logistics (value, duration, distribution).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program objective — attract and retain top-tier postdoctoral talent
rubrics_metrics.description: The Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships program provides funding to the very best postdoctoral applicants, both nationally and internationally, who will positively contribute to the country's economic, social, and research-based growth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program aims to attract and retain top-tier postdoctoral talent; reviewers and applicants should understand the fellowship seeks candidates with exceptional promise and potential contribution to national economic, social, and research priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop leadership potential
rubrics_metrics.description: One objective of the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships program is to develop their leadership potential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should demonstrate the candidate's potential for leadership and trajectory toward becoming a research leader; leadership development is an explicit program goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position for success as research leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: The program aims to position fellows for success as research leaders of tomorrow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should present a plan and evidence showing how the fellowship will enable transition to a research-leadership career (e.g., career trajectory, training, host support).

rubrics_metrics.name: Emphasis on applicant–host synergy
rubrics_metrics.description: The Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships program is unique in its emphasis on the synergy between: the applicant – their individual merit and potential to launch a successful research-intensive career; and the host institution – their commitment to the research program and alignment with the institution's strategic priorities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications are evaluated on both the candidate's merit/potential and the host institution's commitment and strategic alignment. Strong proposals will clearly demonstrate how the applicant's research and career plans align with and are supported by the host institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Host institution endorsement and collaborative application requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: An applicant to the Banting Postdoctoral Fellowships program must complete their application in full collaboration with the proposed host institution. Applicants seek endorsement from host institution to apply, prepare and submit application (institutions may have internal deadlines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must obtain formal endorsement from their proposed host institution and work collaboratively with that institution on the application; institutional internal deadlines may apply and should be observed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and number of awards
rubrics_metrics.description: 70 fellowships are awarded annually; approximately 140 awards are active at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should note the limited number of awards (70/year) and the active award pool (~140), which affects competitiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution among federal research agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships are distributed equally among: the Canadian Institutes of Health Research (CIHR), the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council (NSERC), the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council (SSHRC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should be aware their application will be considered within the context of one of the three federal research council allocations; alignment with the appropriate agency’s mandate may be relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award value
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The fellowship provides $70,000 CAD annually; applicants and host institutions should plan budgets and expectations accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration and renewability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fellowships are awarded for a fixed two-year period and cannot be renewed; applicants should propose a two-year research and career development plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timelines and key dates
rubrics_metrics.description: April to September 2024: Applicants seek endorsement from host institution to apply, prepare and submit application. September 17, 2024 (20:00 EDT): Deadline for complete application submission. October to December 2024: Evaluation of applications. Mid-February 2025: Anticipated notification of results. April to October 2025: Payments begin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must follow the listed timeline (including institutional endorsement period) and meet the application deadline; expect evaluation and notification windows as indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant pool — national and international
rubrics_metrics.description: Program provides funding to postdoctoral applicants both nationally and internationally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility and applicant outreach are international in scope; applicants from outside Canada may apply (subject to any other eligibility rules not listed on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contingent additional awards if more funds available
rubrics_metrics.description: Footnote: Should more funds become available, additional fellowships may be awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Number of awards may increase if additional funding becomes available; applicants should monitor announcements but not rely on additional awards.
